definitions.short: to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt , utter
definitions.full: H6694. tsuq II. [ צוּק ] verb pour out, melt (|| יצק ); — Qal Perfect 3plural (according to Thes and others) צָקוּן Isa 26:16 , but see below; Imperfect 3masculine singular נְחוּשָׁה יָצוּק וְאֶבֶן Job 28:2 (read perhaps יָצוּקוּ , see Bu) and stone (ore, men ) melt it into copper ; מַּלְגֵישָֿׁ֑מֶן עִמָּדִי יָצוּק צוּר 29:6 the rock used to pour out beside me streams of oil. — Isa 26:16 (as above) must mean they poured out (uttered) a whisper ( לַחַשׁ ; i. e. prayer); but form most improbable; Koppe Gr Di Du and others propose לַחַשׁ צְקוֺן (from assumed צָקוֺן , I. צוק ) = constraint of (like that of) magic ; < Houb Kit ׳וגו בְלַחַץ צָֽעֲקוּ , or Che Hpt לָנוּ מוּסָֽרְךָ כִּי מִלַּחַץ צָעַקְנוּ .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of narrowness (of orifice));
